page_sections_spec.layout: Asymmetric 12-column grid. Left 7 cols: Brand pill 'Sovereign Intelligence', H1 'Your personal AI. Sovereign, private, and owned by you.', subhead, Primary CTAs ('Get Agent One' + 'Explore hussh Shop'), and 100% on-device · encrypted · free for life trust badge. Right 5 cols: Interactive 3D/Canvas Shh Mascot with glowing gold pulsing halo ring, live interactive security telemetry card floating beneath.

Tetris Bento Grid with 3 cards: 1) Agent One Dominant visual (col-span-12 lg:col-span-7) with interactive tabs showing live briefing simulator and privacy toggles. 2) Puppy One (col-span-12 md:col-span-6 lg:col-span-5) with playful 3D companion card and habit loop. 3) Tag One (col-span-12) Early access interactive hardware card with instant email waitlist trigger.

3-step visual narrative: Step 1 (Sign in with Google or Apple / Zero identity storage), Step 2 (Choose what to connect - Health, Mail, Calendar, Financials), Step 3 (Get your first morning brief). Features dynamic interactive step preview switcher.
Editorial 4-step interactive card rail: 1. Package Your Data, 2. Set Your Floor Price, 3. Review Anonymous Bids, 4. Instant Sovereign Payout. 'Your info. Your price. Your call.'
High-contrast dark band 'Works seamlessly with your AI tools' featuring interactive logos/chips for Gemini, Siri, ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Meta AI, Copilot, with privacy shield connection status.
Dramatic dark closing section with glowing amber backdrop, direct email reservation box for Agent One Early Access, and live toast confirmation.
6-column mega footer: Product, Directory, Enterprise, Knowledge, Company, Trust Rights & Gratitude, plus sovereign copyright and privacy statement.

visual_enhancers.mascot_svg_spec: Custom crafted high-fidelity SVG/Canvas Shh Mascot with gold finger-to-mouth iconic pose, gold concentric pulsing halo rings, dark sleek specular gradients, and interactive mouse-tilt parallax.
visual_enhancers.background_patterns: Delicate SVG wavy topological lines (opacity 0.08) in hero section referencing the original hussh brand identity, plus fine 1px grid borders in the bento layout.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped gold buttons with dark text (bg-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-300 text-neutral-950 font-semibold px-6 py-3 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(245,166,35,0.25)] transition-all active:scale-95).

accessibility.contrast_standard: APCA & WCAG AA compliant on all defined surfaces
accessibility.testing_attributes: All buttons, inputs, dropdown items, tabs, and interactive cards have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='nav-dropdown-agent-one', data-testid='tag-one-email-input').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace frontend/src/index.css font imports with @fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans and set theme tokens.
2. Implement the full responsive layout in frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx (and supporting modular components in frontend/src/components/hussh/).
3. Build the Shh Mascot component with SVG/Canvas + Motion to give it life, sleek 3D depth, and glowing gold halo.
4. Ensure email submissions (for Agent One and Tag One) connect to backend /api/signup or use Sonner toast with realistic interactive feedback.
5. Implement all 5 nav dropdowns using custom animated menus or @base-ui/react / shadcn dropdowns with rich preview items.
6. Ensure all interactive elements include exact data-testid attributes.
